shots.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic portrait 9:16 WIDE ESTABLISHING keyframe S01 v2 for an outdoor lounger advertisement, no text/logos/watermarks. Image1 is real identity truth: the LIGHT CYAN SKY BLUE elongated lounger lower-left with black lower outer base. Image2 is a proposed scene/color continuity reference only. IMPORTANT CHANGE from image2: use a MUCH WIDER environmental view; the entire lounger must occupy only about 38-42 percent of frame HEIGHT, located in the lower center-right, with plenty of visible lawn all around, no cropped product. A mature leafy tree trunk fills the far left and its canopy frames the top; a modest footpath runs in the distant background with lawn between, tranquil garden and sunlight. Camera standing at a natural slightly elevated three-quarter angle from the product foot-side, wide 28mm photographic feel, warm late afternoon light from upper right, soft leafy shade over the grass, calm believable everyday park. The blue lounger is the inviting focal point through blue/green contrast, surrounded by peaceful space. Preserve the ORIGINAL shape: two soft blue long side volumes and recessed central channel, rounded joined ends, loose mildly shiny wrinkled skin, black lower exterior, no rigid legs or frame, no separate pillow, handles, valves or extra accessories. No person, no additional furniture, no other products. The purpose is to show the use setting of a weekend park break, clearly visually distinct from a tight full-product view. Illustrative concept only, not performance or exact-scale proof.
